target.title: fix(auto-reply): prevent block-reply coalescer from dropping tail text on abort/stop
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
close #102578
Telegram DM block-streaming silently drops the tail of long assistant replies. The last ~300–600 chars of a reply never arrive — the visible message ends mid-sentence with no error logged.

## Why This Change Was Made

Root cause in `block-reply-pipeline.ts`:

1. **`sendPayload` had a `bypassAbort` parameter that was too broad** — every coalescer-sourced payload reached `onBlockReply` via `bypassAbort=true`, bypassing the pipeline's abort gate entirely.

2. **`stop()` didn't flush the coalescer** — on error paths the pipeline was already aborted, but `stop()` only cleared the idle timer. Any remaining buffered text below `minChars` was lost.

### Fix: Replace broad `bypassAbort` with narrow `finalizing` flag

**Pipeline layer** (`block-reply-pipeline.ts`):
- Removed `bypassAbort` param from `sendPayload()` — no more unlimited bypass
- Added `finalizing` flag — only set during `flush({force:true})` and `stop()`
- `sendPayload` checks `aborted && !finalizing` instead of `aborted && !bypassAbort`
- `flush({force:true})` sets `finalizing=true` — coalescer force-flush can deliver buffered tail text even when the pipeline is aborted
- `stop()` sets `finalizing=true`, flushes coalescer, then calls `coalescer.stop()`

**Coalescer layer** (`block-reply-coalescer.ts`):
- `flush({force:true})` bypasses `shouldAbort()` — caller explicitly requested delivery
- `stop()` only clears the idle timer (pipeline owns drain before stop)
- `logVerbose` warning when abort discards buffered text

## Evidence

### Test results (372 tests, all passing)

| Suite | Tests | Status |
|-------|-------|--------|
| `block-reply-pipeline.test.ts` (incl. new regression) | 27 | ✅ |
| `block-reply-coalescer.test.ts` | 9 | ✅ |
| `block-reply-pipeline.multi-message.test.ts` | 3 | ✅ |
| `agent-runner.runreplyagent.e2e.test.ts` | 89 | ✅ |
| `agent-runner-execution.test.ts` | 241 | ✅ |
| `trigger-handling.e2e.test.ts` | 21 | ✅ |
| Full auto-reply serial suite (143 files) | 2960 | ✅ |

### Regression test detail

New test: `delivers buffered coalescer text when a prior sendChain delivery times out before final flush`

Simulates: media sendChain timeout -> pipeline aborted -> coalescer force-flush during finalizing -> buffered tail text delivered -> `hasSentPayload` returns true.

## Related

- Fixes #102578
- Supersedes previous `bypassAbort` approach; replaced with narrow `finalizing` flag
